capabilities: Fetch tasks from Amazing Marvin using an API token
Show a task list in a right-sidebar leaf
Display scheduled tasks in week and month calendar views
Render task blocks in notes with JSON-configured options
extras: Links to external documentation for setup details, and the author requests optional donations (buy me a coffee). Requires Obsidian 1.10.3 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or embed tasks managed in the Amazing Marvin task manager.

relations.evidence: You will need an api token from Amazing Marvin.

summary: Integration that pulls tasks from the Amazing Marvin app into Obsidian via a sidebar list/calendar view and renderable task blocks.
